verdict.rationale: Fenwick's Startup Resource Center references 'Incorporation Stage Issues' and top legal issues for startups, indicating some formation guidance exists, but there is no evidence of specific guidance comparing jurisdictions (UK Ltd, German GmbH/UG, Indian Pvt Ltd) — offices listed are all US-based with no international presence shown. missing for 10: jurisdiction-specific guidance for UK/Germany/India, explicit entity-type comparison content, international office/practice evidence.
